content:
The investigation of FIR/NCRP 1930‑NCRP‑2026‑98124 records a reported loss of INR 4,70,000 originating from seed wallet 0xa7f39c1d8e4b2a5f7c3d9e0a1b8c6d4e5f2a67e9 on 2026‑09‑08 at 10:31:04 +05:30. Fourteen distinct entities were traced through seventeen transfers, with a maximum depth of three hops. Sixteen transfers are confirmed; one additional correlation is inferred. The seed wallet carries a risk score of 65/100 (HIGH), reflecting proximity to a known scam cluster (+20), rapid automated dispersal within three minutes (+15), interaction with a mixer contract (+15) and exposure to a cross‑chain bridge within two downstream hops (+15). Sixteen of the transfers meet or exceed the 30 % reporting threshold, while one falls below it.

The highest‑scoring entities identified are 0x9c04a7e3b21d5f86c0a94e7d2b83f150c6ead21e with a score of 75/100 (CRITICAL), the seed wallet at 65/100 (HIGH), and 0x3f1a7d92c04e8b56af10d3e7b829c45d6e0a71bc with 35/100 (MEDIUM). No individual has been identified as the account holder.
